## Your Office Space Is Offering Free Lease Support to Not-for-Profits in Newcastle and the Hunter

Most not-for-profits operate with tight budgets, small teams, and landlord relationships that feel one-sided.

You've got a lease you signed years ago and haven't looked at since. Or you're searching for a new space and can't afford the commercial advice that for-profit businesses take for granted.

We want to change that — at least in Newcastle and the Hunter.

Your Office Space is offering pro bono lease reviews and relocation search services to not-for-profits in our region. No professional fees. No obligation. Just honest advice from a team that knows commercial property inside out.

## Who This Is For

This programme is open to:

- Registered charities and not-for-profits operating in Newcastle or the Hunter region
- Community organisations, social enterprises, and volunteer-run groups currently in a lease or looking for space
- Any not-for-profit that wants to understand what they're actually signing or where they stand

If that's you, read on.

## What's Included

**Option 1 — Lease Review (Pro Bono)**

If you're already in a lease, we'll review it. Properly.

We'll identify your highest-risk clauses, your financial exposure, and whether you're getting a fair deal. You'll get a plain-English breakdown of what the document actually says — and what it means for your organisation.

This is the same professional review we'd do for a paying client. We're just not charging for it.

**Option 2 — Relocation Search (Pro Bono)**

If you're looking for a new space, we'll run the search for you.

We'll identify suitable properties, negotiate terms on your behalf, and manage the deal through to signing. Tenant representation, done properly, at no cost to you.

We're doing this because we believe not-for-profits deserve the same quality of advice as any commercial tenant — and because Newcastle and the Hunter has a strong community sector that doesn't always get the support it deserves.

## The Reality for Most Not-for-Profits

The leases we see from not-for-profits tend to have the same problems:

- Make-good clauses that weren't negotiated and will cost tens of thousands at exit
- Rent review provisions that don't have caps or guards
- Assignment clauses that don't account for the organisation evolving or merging
- Security requirements that tie up cash the organisation can't afford to lock away

These aren't exotic legal corner cases. They're the standard clauses in standard commercial leases — and they matter.

A $5,000 make-good obligation you didn't know about can derail a small organisation's finances. A rent review clause with no cap can blow out your operating costs by 40% over a five-year term.

Knowing what you're signing matters. Even more so when every dollar is doing real community work.

## How It Works

1. **Fill out the form** at the bottom of this page or visit our dedicated not-for-profit support page.
2. We'll respond within one business day to confirm eligibility and book a 20-minute call.
3. For lease reviews: send us your lease document and we'll deliver the review within five business days.
4. For relocation searches: we'll start the search once we understand your requirements.

Availability is limited to our team's capacity. We can't help everyone, but we'll help as many as we can.

## Why We're Doing This

Commercial property advice shouldn't only be available to businesses that can afford it.

Not-for-profits in Newcastle and the Hunter are doing important work. They deserve good housing — physically and contractually.

We're a tenant-side commercial property team based in Newcastle. We know the local market. We've seen hundreds of leases. And we want to put some of that experience into something that actually matters.

This isn't a marketing stunt. It's not a loss-leader. It's just the right thing to do.

If you're running a not-for-profit in Newcastle or the Hunter and your lease situation could use a second set of eyes — get in touch.

We pick up the phone.
